recommendation: Keep this audit commit as-is for FHIR-12946. Future work about DICOM-derived value set ownership should be handled under broader DICOM terminology issues rather than this URL-specific DSTU2 request.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification request to update the valueset-dicom-cid29 page from http://medical.nema.org/medical/dicom/current/output/html/part16.html#sect_CID_29 to http://dicom.nema.org/medical/dicom/current/output/chtml/part16/sect_CID_29.html.
initial_application: Commit f36c03dbf21cce156df9bcca5a08ba3c544cf55c applied GF#12946 by changing source/imagingstudy/valueset-dicom-cid29.xml from the old large DICOM Part 16 URL to the smaller chtml CID-29 URL. Commit fcf583e852779648d77bcddc72e680ad59405f2b later removed that local value set source and set the ImagingStudy modality binding up as an external DICOM value set using the same smaller URL.
additional_context: FHIR-12947 and FHIR-22483 provide later DICOM terminology context: DICOM began publishing FHIR CodeSystems and ValueSets, and FHIR moved away from local DICOM-derived value set pages. Current source/fhir.ini has no valueset-dicom-cid29 entry, source/imagingstudy/valueset-dicom-cid29.xml is absent, and direct community searches found no conflicting FHIR-12946-specific discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was needed because current source does not contain the obsolete large CID-29 URL or the original local CID-29 value set page; current smaller CID-29 URL occurrences found in source are already correct.
